notes: Smartphone commit-only release. Depth Anything V2 Small Q4 is loaded from models/depth_anything_v2_small_q4.onnx when present; otherwise the official ONNX Community model_q4.onnx is downloaded at runtime and retained in a dedicated Cache Storage bucket. The neural preview has an independent approximately 1 Hz ticker using the latest CameraController frame, while AlvaAR remains the pose authority and selected keyframe depth is still validated by sparse anchors and multi-view geometry before 3D fusion. Preferred neural short side is 140 pixels (multiples of ViT patch size 14), with automatic larger-raster fallbacks.
